title: SpecterBrowserConfig
description: Configuration schema for Specter Dedicated Isolated Chromium Runtime (~/.specter/browser/browser.json)

active_version.description: Active Chromium Golden LTS engine revision

active_runtime.description: Active runtime engine descriptor or alias ('stealth', 'lts')

headless.description: Launch browser in headless background mode by default

viewport_width.description: Default window and viewport render width in pixels

viewport_height.description: Default window and viewport render height in pixels

default_proxy.description: Default proxy server URL for launched browser sessions (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080)

default_cdp_port.description: Default DevTools CDP debugging port for browser automation when --cdp is enabled without port

autoload_extensions.description: List of extensions automatically injected into newly launched profiles

extra_args.description: Extra Chromium command-line switches passed on every profile launch

custom_binary_path.description: Optional absolute path override to custom Chromium executable
